decisions.capability: Retain a database row in an owned native Mac container volume
decisions.evidence_scope: Pinned PostgreSQL image on Apple container retained its row after native stop/start; owned fixtures were removed.
limitations: Mac Documents bind mount stalled; accepted ext4 named-volume behavior does not erase that failure.
Mac-only fixture; no crash/reboot or production durability claim.
decisions.next_gap: Qualify crash/reboot persistence only when that deployment needs it.

decisions.capability: Practice native Git worktrees and GitHub review automation with owned tooling
decisions.evidence_scope: Reuses the existing worktrunk/difftastic/codex-for-claude inventory and acceptance evidence; no new execution was run to freeze this taxonomy layer.
limitations: gh CLI has no separate manifests/stack.json inventory entry in this catalog; it is used as the native GitHub client, not a newly qualified component here.
The codex-for-claude bridge's use stage is partial_acceptance, not full integration.
decisions.next_gap: Qualify gh CLI's own lifecycle evidence as a distinct component and a changed review-bridge version before extending acceptance.

decisions.capability: Create and retire bounded native Git worktrees
decisions.evidence_scope: Native listing and disposable create/list/remove passed; dirty removal was refused without loss.
limitations: Worktrees isolate edits, not permissions, accounts, global settings or shared services.
decisions.next_gap: Prove any required crash cleanup without deleting unrelated or dirty state.

decisions.capability: Enforce the selected filesystem and HTTP network boundaries
decisions.evidence_scope: Permitted/protected filesystem checks and loopback allow/deny HTTP fixtures passed.
limitations: This is not a general escape audit or TLS/SOCKS/network-stack qualification.
decisions.next_gap: Qualify a new protocol/platform boundary if the task actually needs it.

existing_overturn_when: Untrusted code or a deployment target requires a stronger VM/OCI boundary, and the selected alternative passes workload, network, resource, cleanup and host compatibility checks.
limitations: A worktree is not a security sandbox. Ordinary native or Dagu processes are not automatically sandboxed.
Selected access/network fixtures do not certify hostile workloads, resource limits or unsupported platforms.
requirement: Separate edits and apply a real filesystem/network boundary only where the selected task requires enforced restrictions.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
